description: The image shows a wide, multi-lane roadway with no visible sidewalks or pedestrian path; the curb edges appear continuous and there are no clear curb cuts or ramps for pedestrian access. Traffic is separated from the landscaped areas by a curb, with multiple lanes marked by white lines and tall streetlights along the road, but there are no barriers or pedestrian-specific safety features. Landscaping (trees and low shrubs/flower beds) runs continuously along both sides, providing some visual greenery, while the open roadway and lack of pedestrian infrastructure limit walkability and safety.
